subject: How to print only the strongest modification indices when running a CFA?

messages.author: 8481d039482cdcdc
messages.subject: How to print only the strongest modification indices when running a CFA?
parts: I am new to using lavaan and do not know how to perform certain operations that I can perform on Mplus. Is there a function or an instruction which makes it possible to display only the indices of modification decreasing the chi.square of a given value? This function exists on Mplus with the syntax MODINCES (10) for example if I only want the modification indices which decrease the chi two by at least 10. Thank you in advance to whom can and will inform me.

messages.author: 5abdb409f213d464
messages.subject: Re: How to print only the strongest modification indices when running a CFA?

m <- modindices(fit)
m[m$mi > 10, ]

messages.author: 82889e926eb5165e
messages.subject: Re: How to print only the strongest modification indices when running a CFA?
parts:
you can use the sort argument to have them show in order in function of the strongest values, and elect the top ten, for example



modindices(fit, sort=T) ### show sorted mod indices

modindices(fit, sort=T)[1:10,] ### show first 10 rows of sorted mo indices
